description.value: Coastal Eden Cafe is a social enterprise in Vancouver's Downtown Eastside operated by Coastal Church, where all cafe proceeds fund the Eden DTES community program supporting marginalized individuals. The cafe offers a full espresso bar, housemade sandwiches, protein smoothies, and specialty drinks in a welcoming dine-in space designed for people from all walks of life. It also runs a 3–6 month transitional employment and barista training program for individuals facing barriers to work.

address.value: 643 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V6A 1R2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at coastaledencafe.com fully corroborates the OSM address (643 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V6A 1R2) and phone number ((604) 568-3336). The cafe is confirmed open for dine-in with an active menu and online ordering. The website name 'Coastal Eden Cafe' differs from the OSM name 'Eden', which is flagged as a concern. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the website content.
